methodology.summary: Each row is a protocol family in one category (DefiLlama children with the same parent are summed, so Aave V2/V3/V4 are one row). The candidate pool is the union of DefiLlama's top 200 rows by TVL, CoinGecko's top 200 tokens by market cap and the top 20 rows in every category (270 rows); percentiles are computed inside that pool. The score is a weighted sum of percentiles across the pool: size 0.3226, 6-month relative TVL growth 0.2258, 6-month TVL added in dollars 0.1828, 30-day fees momentum 0.1075, 30-day DEX volume momentum 0.0753, token attention (24h turnover) 0.086. Percentiles cannot saturate, so a fresh listing cannot jump the board on a capped growth number. A family with no TVL 180 days ago is marked New: its relative growth is neutral and it is judged on the dollars it has gathered. CoinGecko turnover sits beside DefiLlama, as a percentile across the 70 rows with a mapped token (turnover and netflow are divided by market cap). An unmapped row scores a neutral 0.5. Nansen smart money is off in this build. CEX, Ponzi and token-locker rows are excluded.
methodology.disputes: data/disputes.json: claim-vs-DefiLlama mismatches. Flagged rows show 'data disputed'; scores are not adjusted.
methodology.perps: Perp volume is a paid DefiLlama endpoint (/summary/derivatives, HTTP 402 on the free API), so this row has no volume input: volumeMomentum is the neutral 0.5 and the score leans on TVL and fees. Open interest is read by claim monitors (DEFILLAMA_OI) but is not a score input.

notes: owner() is asserted equal to the Grove Base Executor 0x491EDFB0B8b608044e227225C715981a30F3A44E; the executor is only compared, never called, so it is not drawn.

missing.blocker: doCall is CONTROLLER-only and every fund-moving ForeignController action is RELAYER-only, so no permissionless account can reach the allocator stack.

flow.name: Fluid DEX
flow.summary: One Ethereum-fork swap on Fluid DEX, which has no router: 1 WETH is withdrawn to native ETH and spent as msg.value in swapIn on the USDC/native-ETH Dex pool, asserting the WETH falls by exactly 1, the USDC received equals the pool's Swap amountOut and is within 0.01% of the DexResolver quote, and only gas leaves the ETH balance.

scripts.feature: Swap 1 WETH to USDC on Fluid DEX

nodes.label: fresh impersonated account funded with 1 WETH

edges.label: swapIn(false, 1 WETH, minOut, user) with msg.value
USDC out equal to the Swap amountOut

labels: swapIn(false, 1 WETH, minOut, user) with msg.value

labels: USDC out equal to the Swap amountOut
edges.label: USDC out equal to the Swap amountOut

notes: Fluid DEX has no router: the documented integration path is swapIn on the pool itself, and the quote comes from FluidDexResolver.estimateSwapIn.
Fluid's ETH-sided pools use the native sentinel instead of WETH, so the 1 WETH is withdrawn 1:1 and that exact ETH becomes msg.value with swap0to1 false.
ETH spent is asserted equal to the two transaction fees, so the unwrapped ETH is spent entirely in the swap rather than left in the wallet.
The quote and the swap land in different blocks, so the assertion allows up to 0.01% drift; observed drift is 0.
FluidDexFactory and Fluid Liquidity are only getCode-checked, never called, so they are not drawn.

flow.name: PancakeSwap (DEX)
flow.recipeNote: PancakeSwap V3 on Ethereum (same router addresses as BSC). Set CHAIN=bsc to run it on BSC instead.
flow.summary: Five PancakeSwap tests: a V3 WETH to USDC exactInputSingle on Ethereum (USDC rises), a BSC V2 swapExactETHForTokens (USDT at or above getAmountsOut), a V3 USDT/WBNB mint (NFT owned, liquidity = IncreaseLiquidity event, both legs used), decreaseLiquidity plus collect (liquidity 0, both legs back at 99.9%), and a MasterChef V3 stake (custody moves, userPositionInfos has user/pid/liquidity, pendingCake positive).

pendingCake(tokenId) read after a one-hour warp

notes: Every BSC flow starts from a fresh random account with anvil_setBalance, so no whale is needed; the V2 leg is bought on PancakeSwap's own router.
The V3 router is the same CREATE2 deployment on Ethereum and BSC (so are the factory and NPM, which only the BSC LP flows call); CHAIN=bsc runs that swap script on BSC instead.
MasterChef only books CAKE growth when the V3 pool is touched, hence the extra 0.01 WBNB swap and the one-hour evm_increaseTime before pendingCake is read.
The four V3/NPM/farm assertions are on the NFT owner, liquidity against the IncreaseLiquidity event, collected amounts and pendingCake, not on a token balance alone.

flow.name: Derive V3
flow.summary: One Derive v3 test on an Ethereum fork deposits 100 USDC with depositToNewSubaccount and asserts the L1 delta: the depositor's USDC -100 exactly and SPOT_VAULT's USDC +100 in the deposit block, plus one type-2 PublicActionQueued whose 76-byte payload carries the USDC label, 100 USDC, managerId 1 and the depositor.

scripts.feature: Deposit 100 USDC into Derive V3 (new subaccount)

nodes.label: impersonated USDC holder, a fresh address as the subaccount owner
Derive v3 WITHDRAWAL_OUTBOX, the asset registry
nodes.short: Derive v3 WITHDRAWAL_OUTBOX, the asset regist…

nodes.label: Derive zkVM batch that credits the new subaccount
nodes.short: Derive zkVM batch that credits the new subacc…

edges.label: exactly 100 USDC into SPOT_VAULT in that block

labels: exactly 100 USDC into SPOT_VAULT in that block
edges.label: exactly 100 USDC into SPOT_VAULT in that block

notes: The matrix row that owns this flow is src/catalog/protocolFeatures.js key lyra (Lyra / Derive); its only feature, deposit, is fork:derive-v3:deposit, so this flow has no gap entry.
WITHDRAWAL_OUTBOX.resolveAsset(USDC label) is re-verified on-chain to map to USDC, SPOT_VAULT and 6 decimals, and the manager's own WITHDRAWAL_OUTBOX() must match, so the API label is never trusted.
The zkVM credits the new subaccount asynchronously; a fork can only observe the L1 leg, the exact pull plus the queued public action.
publicActionsAcc must change and publicActionTimes(actionId) must equal the deposit block timestamp, so the queued action is really recorded.
100 USDC is above Derive's documented $10 minimum; funding is a USDC whale via impersonateFunded, no PRIVATE_KEY.

features.title: Deposit 100 USDC into Derive V3 (new subaccount)
features.action: `deposit` on Derive v3 ACTION_MANAGER (OnchainActionManager proxy; depositToNewSubaccount)
features.assertion: depositToNewSubaccount(USDC spot label 0x57B03E14d409ADC7fAb6CFc44b5886CAD2D5f02b, 100 USDC, managerId 1) from a fresh address moves exactly 100.0 USDC: the depositor's USDC falls by 100.0 and SPOT_VAULT's USDC rises by 100.0 in the deposit block, and the OnchainActionManager queues one public action of type 2 (DEPOSIT_TO_NEW_SUBACCOUNT_TYPE) whose 76-byte payload encodes the USDC label, 100.0 USDC, managerId 1 and the depositor, advancing publicActionsAcc; the new subaccount itself is credited asynchronously by the zk batch, which a fork cannot run

contracts.label: Derive v3 WITHDRAWAL_OUTBOX (asset registry: USDC spot label -> USDC token + SPOT_VAULT)
Derive v3 SPOT_VAULT (collateral custody; receives the deposit)
USDC (Ethereum ERC-20 pulled by the deposit)

flow.label: Read-only (V1 vault, sunset)

flow.summary: A read-only check of the sunset GMX V1 book on Arbitrum: USDC in the Vault, GLP total supply, GLP price and AUM still read, and the test asserts vault USDC and GLP supply are both above zero. No transaction is sent and no position is opened.

scripts.feature: Read the sunset GMX V1 book

nodes.label: read-only fork caller, no tx is sent

notes: GMX V1 is sunset: isSwapEnabled() and isLeverageEnabled() read false and mintAndStakeGlp reverts, so GLP minting is not called and no token moves.
Read-only, so there is no impersonated sender; the actor node is the fork RPC caller and the PASS is a state read, not a delta.
V2 perp orders and GM deposits are keeper-executed with signed oracle prices, so they are off this machine and are not drawn.
src/catalog/protocolFeatures.js keys this row as gmx--perps, which the gmx recipe key does not resolve, so this recipe carries no feature matrix and no gap keys.

flow.name: Derive V3
flow.summary: One Derive v3 test on an Ethereum fork deposits 100 USDC with depositToNewSubaccount and asserts the L1 delta: the depositor's USDC -100 exactly and SPOT_VAULT's USDC +100 in the deposit block, plus one type-2 PublicActionQueued whose 76-byte payload carries the USDC label, 100 USDC, managerId 1 and the depositor.

Derive v3 WITHDRAWAL_OUTBOX, the asset registry

notes: The matrix row that owns this flow is src/catalog/protocolFeatures.js key lyra (Lyra / Derive); its only feature, deposit, is fork:derive-v3:deposit, so this flow has no gap entry.
WITHDRAWAL_OUTBOX.resolveAsset(USDC label) is re-verified on-chain to map to USDC, SPOT_VAULT and 6 decimals, and the manager's own WITHDRAWAL_OUTBOX() must match, so the API label is never trusted.
The zkVM credits the new subaccount asynchronously; a fork can only observe the L1 leg, the exact pull plus the queued public action.
publicActionsAcc must change and publicActionTimes(actionId) must equal the deposit block timestamp, so the queued action is really recorded.
100 USDC is above Derive's documented $10 minimum; funding is a USDC whale via impersonateFunded, no PRIVATE_KEY.

flow.name: USDD
flow.summary: One Ethereum-fork mint through the USDD Peg Stability Module: sellGem(user, 100 USDT) pulls the USDT through the gem Join, frobs the PSM urn at tin 0 and exits USDD 1:1, so the caller's USDD balance and USDD totalSupply each rise by exactly 100 USDD while the caller's USDT falls by exactly 100 and SellGem reports a 0 fee.

notes: Approval goes to the gem Join, not the PSM: AuthGemJoin.join does the transferFrom and the PSM passes the original caller through as msgSender.
tin() is asserted 0, so 100 USDT mints exactly 100 USDD and the SellGem fee is 0; a non-zero tin fails the run instead of passing an inexact mint.
USDT is 6 decimals and USDD 18, so the expected mint is amount times 1e12 and the assertion is that exact wei delta.
sellGem frobs the PSM urn in the Vat and exits through the USDD Join; neither the Vat nor the USDD Join is called by the test directly, so neither is drawn.
Only the sellGem direction is tested: buyGem, the USDC PSM with its non-zero tin and the sUSDD savings vault are outside this recipe.

flow.summary: Compound III cUSDCv3 on an Ethereum fork: supply lifts the base balance, withdraw returns exactly 500 USDC and lowers it, borrow lifts borrowBalanceOf, repay cuts it by the USDC spent, absorb zeroes debt and WETH collateral and adds exactly 1 WETH to reserves, and buyCollateral takes exactly quoteCollateral WETH from reserves for 500 USDC and adds that USDC to base reserves.

notes: supply/borrow/repay/withdraw come from src/simulation/fork/compoundV3.js; absorb and buyCollateral come from src/simulation/fork/lendingExtras.js.
WETH collateral enters with supply(WETH, 1) and the borrow is withdraw(USDC, 100) against a 0 base balance on that test's fresh account, so both legs show up in one Comet contract.
absorb moves the seized WETH into Comet's own collateral reserves, so no WETH leaves the contract on that leg; buyCollateral is the leg that pays WETH out.
buyCollateral is a labelled FAIL, with no tx sent, when getReserves() is already at or above targetReserves(): the discount window is closed.

flow.name: Aera
flow.label: Async request + refund
flow.recipeNote: Aera V3 gtUSDa (Gauntlet USD Alpha) on Base, the multi-depositor vault Aera's integration guide documents. Entry is an async requestDeposit to the ProvisionerV2 that Aera's solver fills (usually within 6 hours); the test files one and, after its deadline, refunds it with refundRequest. features.title: Request a deposit and refund it (Aera gtUSDa)
features.assertion: USDC `requestDeposit` (auto price, no solver tip, 1-hour deadline, `minUnitsOut` = 97% of `convertTokenToUnits`) on the gtUSDa ProvisionerV2 on Base. Pre-checks: the vault's `provisioner()` and `feeCalculator()` are the documented ones, async USDC deposits are enabled and the vault is not paused. missing.how: After requestWithdrawals mints the unstETH NFT, impersonate the FINALIZE_ROLE holder (the Lido contract) and call WithdrawalQueueERC721.finalize(requestId, maxShareRate) with msg.value = the request's amountOfStETH, then claimWithdrawal(requestId) as the NFT owner and assert the NFT is burned and the ETH balance rises by the request's amountOfStETH.
missing.blocker: finalize() has no permissionless caller: FINALIZE_ROLE sits with the Lido contract and the ETH it locks comes from the oracle report, so a fresh fork account cannot finalize the request and claimWithdrawal reverts RequestNotFoundOrNotFinalized.
missing.note: Needs an oracle report to finalize the request; finalize() is role-gated.

shieldFee() and getFee() are read on chain (25 bps at the fork block), so a fee change moves the assertion rather than hardcoding 9.975.

nextLeafIndex and merkleRoot move with the fork head, so every check is a delta measured inside the run, never an absolute value.

missing.blocker: Unshield needs a Groth16 zk-SNARK built off-chain over a spendable note; the shield flow zeroes the ShieldCiphertext, so no note can be decrypted or proved, and a fork has no prover.
missing.note: Needs a zk proof generated off-chain.
